title: Externally Checkpointed Cognition / Context-Window Virtualization
objective: Determine whether an ordinary ChatGPT conversation can externalize enough structured task state to resume a nontrivial workflow from a compact external pointer rather than relying on the full conversational transcript.
hypotheses: ECS-003: execution state can be checkpointed externally and used to resume deterministically after interruption.
ECS-004: only active working state must remain in model context while larger task state can live externally and be retrieved selectively.

protocol.rule: On resumption, treat this file and referenced artifacts as authoritative. Do not reconstruct operational state from chat memory except to locate this pointer.
protocol.advance_rule: A phase advances only after a written receipt records inputs, operation, expected result, observed result, and verdict.

completed: Selected ECS-003 and ECS-004 as first controlled capability tests.
Confirmed repository access and existing bci-wire branch.
Created task-manifest.json with an active shard and two intentionally irrelevant archive shards.
Performed same-chat selective replay by fetching state.json, task-manifest.json, and shards/active.json only.
Correctly selected W05 and derived dispatch EXECUTE ORCHID-47/R12:W05#K7P9-M2Q4.
Recorded Phase 2 receipt as PROVISIONAL_PASS because same-chat context contamination could not be excluded.
Ran a genuinely cold ChatGPT context from only the external pointer.
Cold context retrieved state.json, COLD_START.md, task-manifest.json, and shards/active.json only; neither archive shard was retrieved.
Cold context independently selected W05 and derived exact dispatch EXECUTE ORCHID-47/R12:W05#K7P9-M2Q4.
Recorded receipts/phase-3.json with PASS for Phase 3, ECS-003, and ECS-004.

verdict.basis: A genuinely cold context reconstructed the exact continuation from a compact external pointer using selective retrieval and without prior conversational task state or irrelevant archive shards.

next_action: Closed. Use this run as a confirmed specimen in the Emergent Capability Surface map.
